pages.text: In Survival mode, closing a Domain — or having your Domain destroyed — triggers $(bold)Technique Burnout$():$(li)lasts 60 − (Cursed Output level × 5 + Cursed Affinity) seconds, minimum 10 seconds$(li)while active, you cannot expand Domains or use Techniques$(br2)The remaining burnout time is shown on the action bar.$(br2)Creative mode never triggers Burnout.
